elements.name: callbacks
elements.brief: Returns the schema change callbacks of a room: `callbacks(room)` or `callbacks.get(room)`.
elements.description: Returns the schema change callbacks of a room: `callbacks(room)` or `callbacks.get(room)`.

elements.name: protocol
elements.brief: The protocol codes the client and the server exchange.
elements.description: The protocol codes the client and the server exchange.
types: { readonly JOIN_ROOM: 10; readonly ERROR: 11; readonly LEAVE_ROOM: 12; readonly ROOM_DATA: 13; readonly ROOM_STATE: 14; readonly ROOM_STATE_PATCH: 15; readonly ROOM_DATA_SCHEMA: 16; readonly ROOM_DATA_BYTES: 17; readonly PING: 18; readonly ROOM_INPUT_RELIABLE: 19; readonly ROOM_INPUT_UNRELIABLE: 20; readonly ROOM_REQUEST: 21; readonly ROOM_RESPONSE: 22; readonly CODE_MASK: 0x1f; readonly MODIFIER_MASK: 0xe0; readonly MODIFIER_TIMED: 0x80; readonly RESPONSE_STATUS: { readonly OK: 0; readonly REJECTED: 1; readonly ERROR: 2; }; readonly HANDSHAKE_SECTION: { readonly INPUT_REFLECTION: 1; readonly INPUT_OPTIONS: 2; }; readonly INPUT_FLAGS: { readonly RENDER_TIME: 1; readonly FIXED_TIMESTEP: 2; readonly PATCH_RATE: 4; readonly SUB_STEPS: 8; readonly RECKON_TIME: 16; }; readonly CLOSE_CODE: { readonly NORMAL_CLOSURE: 1000; readonly GOING_AWAY: 1001; readonly NO_STATUS_RECEIVED: 1005; readonly ABNORMAL_CLOSURE: 1006; readonly CONSENTED: 4000; readonly SERVER_SHUTDOWN: 4001; readonly WITH_ERROR: 4002; readonly FAILED_TO_RECONNECT: 4003; readonly MAY_TRY_RECONNECT: 4010; }; }

fields.name: ROOM_DATA_BYTES
fields.doc: A room message of raw bytes.

fields.name: PING
fields.doc: A ping, and the pong the server echoes.

fields.name: CODE_MASK
fields.doc: Isolates the base protocol code (the low 5 bits).

fields.name: MODIFIER_MASK
fields.doc: Isolates the modifier bits (the high 3 bits).

fields.name: MODIFIER_TIMED
fields.doc: Marks a body prefixed with the server time and the last processed input.

fields.name: RESPONSE_STATUS
fields.doc: The status byte of a response.
types: { readonly OK: 0; readonly REJECTED: 1; readonly ERROR: 2; }

fields.name: REJECTED
fields.doc: The handler rejected the request; the reason is the payload.

fields.name: ERROR
fields.doc: The handler threw, or there is none; the payload is `{ name, message, code? }`.

fields.name: HANDSHAKE_SECTION
fields.doc: The tags of the sections that follow a join handshake.

fields.name: INPUT_REFLECTION
fields.doc: The reflection of the room's input schema.

fields.name: INPUT_OPTIONS
fields.doc: The input feature flags and rates.

fields.name: INPUT_FLAGS
fields.doc: The flags of an input options section.
types: { readonly RENDER_TIME: 1; readonly FIXED_TIMESTEP: 2; readonly PATCH_RATE: 4; readonly SUB_STEPS: 8; readonly RECKON_TIME: 16; }

fields.name: RENDER_TIME
fields.doc: Reliable inputs carry the snapshot-timeline stamp.

fields.name: FIXED_TIMESTEP
fields.doc: A tick rate in Hz follows.

fields.name: PATCH_RATE
fields.doc: A patch rate in milliseconds follows.

fields.name: RECKON_TIME
fields.doc: Reliable inputs carry the reckon-timeline stamp.

fields.name: CLOSE_CODE
types: { readonly NORMAL_CLOSURE: 1000; readonly GOING_AWAY: 1001; readonly NO_STATUS_RECEIVED: 1005; readonly ABNORMAL_CLOSURE: 1006; readonly CONSENTED: 4000; readonly SERVER_SHUTDOWN: 4001; readonly WITH_ERROR: 4002; readonly FAILED_TO_RECONNECT: 4003; readonly MAY_TRY_RECONNECT: 4010; }

fields.name: WITH_ERROR
fields.doc: The room closed with an error.

fields.name: MAY_TRY_RECONNECT
fields.doc: The client may try to reconnect.

functions.name: select_by_latency
functions.brief: Measures the latency of each endpoint and calls back with a client for the fastest.
functions.description: Measures the latency of each endpoint and calls back with a client for the fastest.

parameters.name: endpoints
parameters.doc: The endpoints to compare, each a URL or its settings.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc:
Receives the fastest endpoint's client, or an error when the list is
empty or no endpoint responded.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.doc: Seconds to wait for each endpoint (default: 1.5).

functions.name: get
functions.brief: Returns the schema change callbacks of a joined room's state, as calling the module does.
functions.description: Returns the schema change callbacks of a joined room's state, as calling the module does.
